name: Grapefruit / Pomelo (Citrus paradisi / Citrus maxima)

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Destroys enterocyte CYP3A4 enzymes, collapsing first-pass drug metabolism and causing up to 12-fold spikes in bioavailability for oral CYP3A4 substrates (statins, calcium channel blockers, immunosuppressants, PDE5 inhibitors).

guidance: Completely avoid grapefruit, pomelos, and Seville oranges for the entire duration of therapy. Normal intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme turnover takes up to 72 hours to regenerate after ingestion.

name: Spinach / Swiss Chard (High-Oxalate & High-Vitamin K Greens)

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Exogenous vitamin K directly reactivates hepatic clotting factor synthesis (Factors II, VII, IX, X), rapidly decreasing INR and precipitating thromboembolism or stroke in warfarin patients.
Binds free ionic calcium, iron, and magnesium into insoluble oxalate crystals in the gastrointestinal lumen, rendering them biologically unabsorbable and increasing nephrolithiasis burden.

guidance: Warfarin patients must keep leafy green intake strictly consistent day-to-day. When taking calcium or iron supplements, separate from high-oxalate greens by at least 2 to 3 hours.

name: Aged Cheese, Cured Meats & Fermented Foods (High-Tyramine)

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Under monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibition, ingested dietary tyramine escapes intestinal deamination, enters systemic circulation, and displaces massive catecholamine stores, triggering acute fatal hypertensive crises, intracranial hemorrhage, and cardiac arrest.

guidance: Strict dietary tyramine restriction is required starting on the first day of MAOI therapy and continuing for 14 days after discontinuation to allow MAO enzyme regeneration.

name: Green Tea, Black Tea & Matcha (Tannins & OATP Inhibitors)

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Tannins form insoluble macromolecular iron-tannate precipitates, dropping non-heme iron absorption by up to 80%. Catechins additionally inhibit intestinal OATP uptake transporters, drastically reducing bioavailability of beta-blockers (atenolol) and allergy medications (fexofenadine).

guidance: Do not take oral iron supplements with tea; drink tea between meals at least 2 hours apart. If taking fexofenadine or nadolol, avoid green tea within 4 hours.

name: Coffee & High-Caffeine Beverages (Espresso, Energy Drinks)

bioactiveCompounds.effect: Competitive substrate clearance inhibition & sympathomimetic synergy
bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Ciprofloxacin, fluvoxamine, and oral contraceptives inhibit CYP1A2, reducing caffeine clearance by 30-80% and precipitating palpitations, panic, and severe tremors. Caffeine also accelerates gastric motility, impairing bisphosphonate and thyroid absorption.

guidance: Take thyroid hormones and bisphosphonates with pure plain water only. Moderate or avoid concentrated caffeine during ciprofloxacin therapy.

name: Potassium-Enriched Salt Substitutes (Low-Sodium Table Salt)

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Provides 500-1400 mg potassium per 1/4 teaspoon. When renal potassium excretion is suppressed by ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or aldosterone antagonists (spironolactone), acute severe hyperkalemia (>6.5 mEq/L) can trigger sudden flaccid paralysis and fatal ventricular fibrillation.

guidance: Strictly verify ingredients of low-sodium seasonings. Avoid potassium-chloride based salt alternatives completely if taking Lisinopril, Losartan, or Spironolactone.

name: Dairy Milk, Yogurt & Calcium-Enriched Foods

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Divalent calcium binds fluoroquinolone (ciprofloxacin) and tetracycline (doxycycline) antibiotics into unabsorbable ring complexes, reducing systemic antibacterial coverage by up to 90% and causing therapy failure.

guidance: Separate all dairy ingestion from oral antibiotics, bisphosphonates, and thyroid medications by at least 2 to 4 hours.

name: Natural Black Licorice & Licorice Root Extracts

bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Inhibits cortisol breakdown into cortisone in the kidney. Cortisol saturates mineralocorticoid receptors, causing massive renal sodium retention, severe potassium wasting, edema, and dangerous spikes in blood pressure that neutralize antihypertensives.

guidance: Do not consume natural black licorice (or non-deglycyrrhizinated licorice supplements) if managing hypertension, heart failure, or taking potassium-wasting diuretics.

name: Fresh Orange Juice & Apple Juice (OATP Influx Blockers)

bioactiveCompounds.effect: Intestinal active drug uptake transport inhibition
bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Unlike CYP3A4 inhibitors that increase drug levels, fruit juice bioflavonoids block the enterocyte OATP influx pumps, plummeting absorption of oral fexofenadine (Allegra), ciprofloxacin, and atenolol by 30-70%.

guidance: Take fexofenadine (Allegra) and atenolol with plain water only. Avoid drinking fruit juices within 4 hours before or after dosage.

name: Alcoholic Beverages (Beer, Wine, Spirits)

bioactiveCompounds.effect: Synergistic CNS depression, disulfiram reactions & hepatotoxicity
bioactiveCompounds.clinicalDescription: Multiplies respiratory depression and profound sedation with opioids and sedatives; blocks hepatic lactate uptake with metformin (lactic acidosis); triggers acute disulfiram-like vomiting and tachycardia with metronidazole; and accelerates dose-dumping in extended-release capsules.

guidance: Completely abstain from alcohol while taking metronidazole, cephalosporins, prescription sedatives, or empty-stomach metformin.
